content.short: Lorenzo turns idle Bitcoin into liquid yield tokens such as stBTC and enzoBTC, and offers sUSD1+ for BTC-backed dollar yield.
content.description: Lorenzo Protocol, backed by YZi Labs, presents itself as institutional-grade onchain asset management with Bitcoin at the centre. Depositors mint stBTC or enzoBTC, which stay liquid and can be used in DeFi while the underlying BTC earns. For dollar exposure, sUSD1+ provides a stable token with yield linked to Bitcoin strategies. The products run across Bitcoin, BNB Chain, Ethereum and Sui. sUSD1+ is issued under its On-chain Traded Fund model, which packages quantitative strategies into a single tradable token, and Lorenzo offers the same OTF tooling for others to launch tokenized funds.
